verdict.rationale: Bolna's own materials claim high call volume and scalable deployments: the marketing site promises 'thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute', and the self-hosting docs describe Docker/Kubernetes deployments as 'scalable'. However, the pack never documents concurrency limits, quotas, or a self-serve way to raise capacity, so the 'documented limits' and 'without manual capacity begging' parts of the story go unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented per-account concurrency limits, self-serve or automatic limit increases, a rate-limit or quota reference, independent load or scale corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging

citations.quote: Power thousands of inbound and outbound calls every minute
self-host Bolna Voice AI on your own servers using Docker or Kubernetes for secure, private, and scalable enterprise deployments
